info.name: crAPI Payments Service
info.description:
Payment simulation microservice for crAPI. All endpoints require the 5 security headers generated by the pre-request scripts. Collection-level scripts generate fresh timestamps, request IDs, and idempotency keys per request.

State machine: auth → reversal | capture → void-capture | refund → void-refund

Run the 'Full Chain' folder in order to exercise the complete auth→capture→refund→void-refund flow.

variable.description: Set by 'Auth' request (short code e.g. AUTH-1234)

// Unique request ID for dedup (UUID v4 without dashes, max 64 chars)
var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0, v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
// Idempotency key (new per request — override per-request if you want replay testing)

item.name: Full Chain
item.description: Run these requests in order to exercise: auth → capture → partial refund → void-refund. Transaction IDs are chained automatically via collection variables.

request.description: Authorize a card for $150.00. Saves transaction_id and auth_id to collection variables.
Capture the authorized amount. References authTxnId set by step 1.
Refund $50.00 of the $150.00 capture. remaining_refundable should be $100.00 (10000 cents).
Cancel (void) the refund from step 3. remaining_refundable on the capture is restored to full $150.00 (15000 cents).

item.name: Individual Operations
item.description: Each operation standalone. Auth ID and transaction IDs must be set manually or populated by running the Full Chain folder first.

request.description: Void an authorization. auth_id goes in the URL path (not the body). Requires authId variable set by an Authorize call.

item.name: Error Scenarios
item.description: Verify middleware guards and state machine rejections.

request.description: No X-RequestID, X-Levo-* headers — should get 400 missing_headers.
Merchant not in PAYMENTS_ALLOWED_MERCHANT_IDS — should get 403 merchant_not_allowed.
Timestamp outside the ±5 minute replay window — should get 400 timestamp_out_of_window.
Attempt to refund more than the captured amount. Requires captureTxnId to be set. Should get 422 refund_exceeds_captured.
Try to capture a sale transaction (wrong operation type). Should get 422 invalid_state.
Reference a non-existent transaction UUID. Should get 404 transaction_not_found.

item.name: Lifecycle Chain
item.description: Plan -> Subscription -> (mass assignment) -> prorated cancellation. Step 1 exposes its id only via the Location header. The prorated cancel issues a real CREDIT transaction that the core payment endpoints can act on.

request.description: Chain root. 201; the new plan id is only in the Location header.
Uses planId from step 1. Holds the card as a $0 auth in payment_transaction.
VULN [API3]: ?expand=payment_method returns the stored PAN and CVV.
VULN [API3-BOPLA]: current_period_end and price_override are writable. Extending the period inflates the credit that step 5 pays out.

VULN [Business Logic]: unused time is divided by ONE plan interval, so the extended period yields a credit far above one period. Proration also ignores price_override. Re-send to issue a second credit for the same period.
The lifecycle credit is a real transaction, readable through the pre-existing core endpoint.
